name: io.github.degibug-del/laserbrain
description: The drift harness as an MCP server. Offline, no key — a fixed reference an agent checks against.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: Pin the exact version this entry names. uvx resolves to the newest PyPI release by default, so without this an older, no-longer-latest registry entry would silently invoke a different package than the one it describes. Keep this version in sync with the two above it — check-registry-entry.py asserts all three agree.

packageArguments.description: Run as an MCP server on stdin/stdout.
